minio.storageClassInlineDefaultsBasis: fresh data directory, no MINIO_STORAGE_CLASS_* / inline variables; single-drive MinIO exposes no storage_class admin subsystem (captured as <unknown-subsystem> in the hashed configuration)

host.device: ext4 on a dm-delay mapper over a loop device (created per run); live staging: ext4 loop image /var/lib/testinbox-minio/ext4.img mounted rw,relatime

uploadImplementationNote: harness.py implements the ADR §5 shape (presigned single-part PUT, signed content-length and If-None-Match: *, one attempt, abort by RST after TIOCOUTQ=0); the application's FencedUploader declares the same version

qualification.platform: the staging host itself: Contabo VPS vmi2932906, KVM, x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04, Docker 29.x; privileged harness container on the host kernel
qualification.procedure: docs/adr/0035-benchmark/minio-probes/QUALIFICATION.md; qualification/run-slow.sh --mode dm with plan.json, plan3.json and plan-slow.json, each swept after >= 17 min
qualification.slowWMechanism: dm-delay (device-mapper delay target over the loop device), write delay 500 ms / 2000 ms
